messages.content: 在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which to calculate the boiling point.

pressure.description: The pressure at which to calculate the boiling point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of the pressure. Default is 'kPa'.

message.content: 在10 kPa（約0.1 atm）的條件下，水的凝固點大約是 **-2 °C**。這個值比標準大氣壓（101.3 kPa）下的0 °C略低，因為降低壓力會使水的凝固點下降。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？" They want the freezing point of water at 10 kPa. The tool provided calculates boiling point, not freezing point. There's no tool for freezing point. So we cannot use the tool. We need to answer manually. The freezing point of water at 10 kPa? At lower pressure, freezing point decreases slightly. At 10 kPa (~0.1 atm), the freezing point is about -2°C? Actually, at 0.1 atm, the freezing point is about -2°C. But we can approximate. The user didn't specify units. We can give approximate answer. We should not call the tool.
